description: Current WordPress versions and changes in one dated call. Use before writing or reviewing WordPress code, or when a version or API question comes up: current versions (WordPress, Gutenberg, PHP, WP-CLI, MCP Adapter), the next release, and what changed recently with what to do about it (deprecations, new APIs, AI and MCP). Once per task is enough. Pass `since` (your training cutoff) or `area` for the full details. For articles and announcements, use wp_news.

area.description: Only changelog entries for this area

limit.description: Maximum changelog entries (default 8, or 50 with area or since)

since.description: Only changes on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD), e.g. your training cutoff

name: wp_now
title: WordPress right now
